title: Orchestra-SF: exact blast-radius test disposition and final qualification plan

delivery.mutationScope: docs/architecture only; no product, test, workflow, environment, shared-branch or deployment mutation

scope.target: Bun + SF Web production Linux x64
scope.executionSurface: GitHub Actions after implementation and actual prerequisite admission
scope.outsideSfRows: Retained generic/historical product contracts with explicit replacement obligations; no false SF proof credit.

precedence: This normalized catalog, its gates and integrationOverrides govern selection, parent execution and final qualification. Domain/supplement documents retain detailed source evidence. Original migration plan retains architecture and A01-A46; older candidate lists and example runners are superseded by this exact catalog.
countingRules: Tests are unique repository paths, not executed cases. Existing and proposed are counted separately.

154 support paths include 152 files and two generated directories, not standalone test selections. Additional gate scripts/manifests/workflows are defined in gates.newFiles/contracts rather than silently counted as test files.

224 additional structural parent tests are outside the individually classified 638 test rows. Their source blob/import relations and full-CI-SF execution obligation are recorded without claiming body semantic review.
46 acceptance criteria are cross-referenced to exact tests; acceptance-map testCatalog is the earlier 91-path crosswalk subset, not a competing count of all 638.
14 original UI cases and 50 existing native registrations are source inventory counts, not observed executed counts. AZ02's 32 cases/six phases are operational proof, not unit-test count.
Front-specific scan/body/import counts overlap and must not be added as total monorepo coverage.

actionDefinitions.CHANGE_CONTRACT: Edit the specified fixture/authority/selector/serialization/expectation contract, preserve the listed business and safety assertions, add the stated negatives.
actionDefinitions.CHANGE_FIXTURE: Adapt construction/admission/owner/revision plumbing; preserve business outcomes and assertions. No wholesale snapshot rewrite.
actionDefinitions.KEEP_REGRESSION: Keep the existing technical/business meaning; run under the assigned final gate. Do not change a name merely because it contains project/profile.
actionDefinitions.REMOVE_SF_CASE: Retire the repo/Desktop-specific SF acceptance assumption with a named executable replacement. Do not delete the whole file or add skip/xfail.
actionDefinitions.NEW: Proposed executable path absent at pin; implementation and existence/selection validation required before execution.
actionDefinitions.SUPPORT: Imported helper, fixture, generated output or runner support. parentExecution is the normalized authoritative execution relation; raw parents preserve original reviewer wording and are not selectors.
actionDefinitions.STRUCTURAL_REGRESSION_PARENT: Additional importer/consumer reached through a changed shared helper; preserve cases and run the full assigned suite. Not semantically reviewed in this supplement.
actionDefinitions.OUTSIDE_SF: Explicitly excluded from final Linux SF Web qualification, with reason and replacement; preserve generic/historical contract.

originalFixtureClosure.review: Relevant constructors and assertions; not whole file or monorepo semantic review.
